---
id: env.endorsement-library
type: library
heading: Endorsement Library
since: 1.0.0
status: draft
---

An endorsement applies only if its code is shown in the schedule. Each endorsement changes this policy only as it states, and is read together with the variables shown for it in the schedule. Where an endorsement and the rest of this policy conflict, the endorsement applies to the extent of the conflict. If a variable an endorsement needs is not shown in the schedule, the default stated in the endorsement applies; if it has no default, the endorsement does not apply until we show the variable in the schedule. These endorsements are for use with this wording at version 1.0.x.

| Code | Endorsement | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| E01 | Pre-existing Conditions | Covers pollution conditions at a covered location that began before the retroactive date, to a sub-limit |
| E02 | Transported Cargo | Covers pollution conditions from cargo you transport, beyond the job site |
| E03 | Non-owned Disposal Sites | Covers pollution conditions at disposal sites you sent waste to |
| E04 | Project Term | Insures one named project for its own term and limit |
| E05 | Asbestos Abatement | Writes back cover for asbestos abatement work, to a sub-limit |
| E06 | Prior Acts | Sets an earlier retroactive date where you had continuous prior cover |
| E07 | Business Interruption | Covers your loss of income while a covered location is closed for clean-up |
